tei:div.tei:p: (561)'phags ma'i cho ga'i yan lag ro sreg rus sbyangs patstsha rab gnas phyogs gcig du dril ba bzhugs so/ (562)na mo ārya ta re yeḥ de la dang po gshin po rjes bzung phung po sreg sbyong bya ba la/las bzhi'i de las ro sreg kyi khyad par ni/ sngar bshad ba'i dri ba kyi khar ba gu sogs kyi ro mu rgyar khru gang gi tshad dang dbang du ji ltar rigs pa cig par byed kyi me tshong mche srog rdzas rnams tshang bar lus byas la gnas lung dngos gzhi'i lam sbyangs bstan yan chad song nas ro khang rnying pa las gud du rungs te/ sngar bzhin bgegs la gtor ma btang nas drag sngags bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas pas rten la yungs thun gyis brabab gu gul gyis gdugs pa sogs bgegs bskrad/ sgribs sbyongs ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i bye yungs kyis brab cing bum chus bkrus dri bzang gi byugs/ stod g.yog dang smad g.yog dkris/ gnas gsum sogs su btags grol dang gnas yig rim pa ci 'byor btags/ skad cig gis rje btsun ma bskyed cung zad mchod cing bstod ma rab sogs stan srab (563)

mo'i khyogs la bteg nas rol mo dang bcas pas thabs kyi nang du cung zad rgu bar bzhag pa'i mdun dngos su shing phra ba dang rgyab rnams cung zad sbom pas gtser ba'i phyi'i mdun gyi rtsa bar sbar khung*/ sked pa rdzas khung*/ steng du dud khung rnams ma gtogs gzhan thams cad mtshams shing brtan par brtsigs dkar rtsis byug cing gdug phug pa sogs bya/ bdag bskyed sogs sngags bzhir song nas bsregs rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i bran la/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg la/ oṃ swā hā rdzas rnams bkru/ lam shing la/ oṃ a swā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shri swā hā/ 'bru rnams la/ oṃ jiṃ swā hā rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sogs dang*/ sbyin sreg gzhung bzhin me sbar ba ni/ hūm̐/ nyon cing tshe 'das/ sogs nas me sbar rol mo bcas mar (564) khu'i thig pas mi gos/ oṃ ta re tam̐ swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i ku sha phran la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/ dkon mchog gsumo mnyes ba byed pa/ sa la skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*/ bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ zhi dang bkra shes mdzad du gsol/ swā hā/ sogs brjod/ gang zag mchog yin na rten dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med du bya zhing dman pa rnams la sha khrag bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi mchod rdzu du dmigs pa yin la/ spel tshig la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba pa paṃ ga te ga te swā hā/ tshe 'das 'das pa'i las sgrib bgags thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swā hā/ dkyus bzhin rdzas rnams 'bul bas dmigs yul rje su dran pas de la phan pa'i bsam pas bzlas shing*/ sbyin sreg lha rdzas mi las ye shes 'od zer dkar po 'phros dmigs yul la thim pa de'i sdig sgrib kyi nyes pa thams cad sim bar bsam la/ 'don sgom bya'o/ rgyud las/ ngan song rgyud na gnas pa yi/ sems can rjes su dran byed cing*/

bslas dang sbyin sreg 'di byed (565) pas/ nyes pa thams cad zhi nas kyang*/ zhes sogs chos 'di nyid ston pa'i rgyud nas gsungs/ gnyis patstsha gdab pa'i cho ga ni de ltar ro sreg tshar ba'i rjes su/ rang nyid lha de'i dpyal gyis/ badzra saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes rus bu rnams bsdus la rin chen sogs kyi snod du bzhag de'i steng du mañdzu'i khar rin po che'i bum pa sman dang dri bzang gi chus gang ba dang*/ nye logs su ba byung lnga'i snod dang ga bur gur gum sogs dri bzang gi chu'i snod kyang so sor bshams/ rus bu'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i a dkar po 'phra ba de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par/ bsam la rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba pa paṃ ga te ga te swā hā/ 'a a ha sha sa ma/ ma ma ko ling sa manta tshe las 'das pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad shintaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ sogs mang du bzlas nas bum chus rdzas thams cad ma gdab cing rus bu rnams dag par krus de nyid zhib par sbyangs nas sngar gyi bum chu dang (566) ba byung lnga rnams lhan gcig tu sbyang ba slar yang dri bzang dang sa bzang gi'ajim pa rnams bsres pas snying po bzla bzhin brjis la/ 'jig pa rin po che'i phung por bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'og min du rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung bas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs 'jim pa la thim pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ bar bsam la/ lag g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bo mnan pa gyen bstan dang*/ g.yas pa'ang de bzhin du kha sbub pa'i bar du 'jim pa bzhag pa rnam snang gi gzungs ring ngam yang na/ oṃ ji na jikā swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig dang gong gi sngags sham yig brgya byin rlabs/ oṃ badzra a bu ṣe swā hā/ rdo rje srog thob par bsam la 'jim pa bcad/

oṃ badzred bha wa swā hā/ ye shes rdo rje 'byung bar bsam la 'chi 'chi bya/ oṃ a (567)ra je ba ra je swā hā/ ye shes rdul bral du bsam la rdzi byug oṃ dharma dhatu garbha swā hā/ chos kyi dbyings snying po rnyed par bsam zhing bskos phor du btsun/ oṃ badzra mag ra a ka ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phyag rgya gdab par bsam la gdab/ oṃ sarba birgya swā hā/ ye shes snying po khong du chud par bsam la gur gum gyis brin pa'i rtsa sngags sham can dang rten 'brel snying po gzungs gzhug oṃ dharma ra ta swā hā/ chos sku las gzugs sku grub par bsam zhing phyir 'don/ aṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad de la brtan par bzhugs par bsam la me tog 'thor zhing brtan par bya'o/ gsum pa rab tu gnas shing patstsha sgrub pa dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ las bum du skad cig gis bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra amṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ (568)hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci zhus bzlas mthar/ lha 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ par bsam patstsha rnams stegs bu'i khar legs bkod pa'i mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor dang*/ sbyangs chas sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bsogs/ bgegs sbyang ba'i tshig dkyus bzhin ba'i 'dra ba'i khyad par/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs so sbyar/ mtshams gcad/ ji ltar bltam pa sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs/ pha rol phyin drug rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la/ sogs/ de dag sku la/ sogs tshang bar bya/ rten la/ amṛ tas/ bsangs byu ne tas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ges bstegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du a las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa (569)de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/

dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skril po krung gis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa badzra sa ma ya ja ja hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim dbang lhas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lus pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ/ sogs kyis mchod/ phyag byar 'os pa/ sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas spyan dbye ba'i tshul dang bcas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*/ gus pas 'phags (570)pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtug gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog zhes dang*/ oṃ tsakyu tsakyu sa manta tsakyu bi shwa dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ bskyed pa'i lha yongs su gyur pa las rten rang gi rnam par gyur/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ sogs kyi mthar/ su pra tiṣṭha dang ye dharma mang du bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor/ me tog dam pa sogs kyis mchod/ phyag byar/ sogs kyis bstod shis brjid byas par bya'o/ gnyis pa/ sgrub pa'i cho ga ni rab tu gnas pa'i patstsha rnams kyi mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mamachod pa rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ rnal 'byor me tog sogs/ oṃ badzra sogs dang nam mkha'i mjod kyi sngags mthar/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ gi byin gyis rlabs/ de (571) nas pātstsha rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rin po che'i mchod rten yangs shing rgya che ba patstsha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa'i dbus su/ bhrūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sogs nas cho ga'i dkyus ltar du bstod pa'i 'jug bar tshang bar bya/ bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid rje btsun ma gsal ba'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs bzhin pas dmigs yul dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyang du gsol/

snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs rje btsun sgrol ma'i go 'phang la bkod par (572)gyur/ ces dmigs la gong bzhin rtsa sngags klong drug 'khor ba dong sprug spel tshig bcas sbyar la bzlas so/ thun mthar mchod bstod dang nongs bshags/ mchod rten lha dang bcas pa zhu ba las patstsha'i rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ slar yang gong gi rab gnas skabs ltar mchod bstod dang*/ brtan bzhugs bya bdag bskyed bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis brjod dkyus ltar bya'o/ de ltar sngags 'bum phrag gcig gam gnyis sam/ mchod rten las 'od 'bar ba la sogs pa'i rtags kha mthong gi bar du bzla bar gsungs so/ de ltar tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i patstsha ni/ mchog phal gang yin kyang rten gyi nang du bzhugs pa dang khang bu brtsegs 'i rten sogs bgyis rung mdo/ yang na rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa'i chu klung chen por de bzhin gshegs pa'i shul phra rab du bsam la smon lam dang bcas pas legs par spyan drangs par bya'o/ de ltar sgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyud las/ des ni nges par dmyal gnas gang*/ de byas pa ni grol bar 'gyur/ yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las/ grol de lta yi gnas su skye/ zhes sogs (573)(574) rgya cher sngags pa la yid ches pa'i ngang pa brtan por 'bad par bya'/ zhes pa'ang smyo shul bla ma tshul khrims bzang po blo dman rang 'dra dpe khyer mkhan rnams la phan pa'i slad du bskul ngor 'od gsal rin chen snying po padma las 'brel rtsal gyis gzhung gi ngang 'don snying por dril te 'brel thog rnams bde 'gro thob pa'i smon lam bcas bris pa dge// /
